title: Safe Superintelligence Partnered with Nvidia
raw_excerpt: Safe Superintelligence announced a long-term partnership with Nvidia that includes an undisclosed investment and access to the Vera Rubin GPU platform.
summary: Ilya Sutskever 创立的 Safe Superintelligence 宣布与英伟达达成长期合作伙伴关系，英伟达将进行未公开金额的投资，并为其提供 Vera Rubin GPU 平台。此举标志着前沿 AI 安全研究获得顶级算力支持，也体现了英伟达对 SSI 技术路线的认可。

title: Releasing the model weights and technical report of Kimi K3
raw_excerpt: Moonshot has released the model weights for Kimi K3, along with a technical report. Kimi K3 is a 2.8T Mixture-of-Experts model with native visual understanding. It has a 1-million-token context window and a new model architecture that gives it 2.5x the intelligence per unit of compute. Alongside Kimi K3, Moonshot is opening up more of the stack behind it — high-performance attention kernels, a MoE communication library, and infrastructure for running agent environments at scale.
summary: 月之暗面正式开源 Kimi K3 模型权重及技术报告。Kimi K3 是一个 2.8T 参数的混合专家模型，具备原生视觉理解能力，支持 100 万 token 上下文窗口，新架构使每单位计算智能提升 2.5 倍。同时开源了高性能注意力内核、MoE 通信库等基础设施。

title: Perplexity’s Personal Computer turns Windows PCs into AI agents
raw_excerpt: Perplexity has expanded its agentic Personal Computer tool to Windows, allowing computers running the world's most popular OS to be used as a locally run AI system. Like the Mac version that Perplexity launched in April, Personal Computer for Windows operates like a "general-purpose digital worker" that can access local files and apps to perform actions on your behalf, such as creating documents and updating spreadsheets. This launch builds on Personal Computer integrations that Perplexity launched for Microsoft's 365 workspace apps and Teams virtual meeting software in May. summary: Perplexity 将其 Personal Computer 智能体工具扩展至 Windows 平台，使 Windows PC 可作为本地运行的 AI 系统使用。该工具类似“通用数字员工”，可访问本地文件和应用程序执行创建文档、更新电子表格等操作，此前已支持 Mac 和 Microsoft 365 应用。

title: Industry Leaders Unite in Open Secure AI Alliance for AI Safety and Security
raw_excerpt: The Open Secure AI Alliance, featuring leaders like NVIDIA and Microsoft, aims to enhance AI safety by using open source technologies to address vulnerabilities. This initiative provides defenders with open defensive tools, enhancing transparency and adaptability while avoiding reliance on closed systems. The alliance encourages policymakers to view open models and tools as assets in AI and cybersecurity strategy, promoting resilience and shared security in the AI era.
summary: NVIDIA 和微软等领导者共同成立 Open Secure AI 联盟，旨在通过开源技术解决 AI 漏洞，增强 AI 安全性。该联盟为防御者提供开放的防御工具，提高透明度和适应性，并鼓励政策制定者将开放模型和工具视为 AI 和网络安全战略的资产。

title: Discovering Cryptographic Weaknesses with Claude
summary: Anthropic 发布研究报告，展示 Claude 在发现密码学弱点方面的能力。研究团队利用 Claude 成功实施了对 HAWK-256 哈希算法的实际密钥恢复攻击，并开源了相关演示代码，展示了 AI 在密码分析领域的潜力。

title: Molt Agentic Reinforcement Learning Framework (GitHub Repo)
raw_excerpt: Molt is a PyTorch-native framework that treats the agent itself as the program and supports custom Python rewards, tool use, multimodal environments, and LLM judges. Its compact stack combines Ray, vLLM, NVIDIA AutoModel, and FSDP2 to scale training to trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts models.
summary: NVIDIA 开源 Molt 智能体强化学习框架，这是一个 PyTorch 原生框架，将智能体本身视为程序，支持自定义 Python 奖励、工具使用、多模态环境和 LLM 评判。其紧凑栈结合 Ray、vLLM、NVIDIA AutoModel 和 FSDP2，可扩展至万亿参数 MoE 模型训练。
